item.title: GoGoGrandparent (YC S16) 正在招聘后端工程师
item.description:
📝 What gets us excited now (and what we’re hiring for) is that technically this ‘self-management problem’ doesn’t just stop at rides. People have known this for a long time and that’s inspired a lot of the solutions that older adults currently have. GoGo is working to make sure that losing your youth doesn’t mean losing your independence.

item.title: “合作”纯属扯淡
item.description:
📝 They moved when they were ordered and they held their positions, and they mimicked the outward appearance of a soldier in battle - but shoot, they did not. Marshall's riflemen were ordinary people responding to the diffusion of responsibility that happens inside any group. Communication overhead grows faster than headcount, coordination costs compound, and every new person contributes their capacity along with their relationships to everyone else.
🔤 Original: "Collaboration" Is Bullshit
🔗 Read more: https://www.joanwestenberg.com/collaboration-is-bullshit/
